title: Find the bug
prompt: A pair search stores the current value before looking for its complement. For input [3,3] and target 6, what goes wrong?
explanation: The first 3 is stored before the complement is checked. When the same element is considered, the map points back at its own index, so the solution uses one position twice.

misconceptions.explanation: Checking after storing the current value can make the lookup return the current index itself.
misconceptions.retry: For [3,3], decide whether lookup or storage comes first and why.
